evidence.note: Sustained 'Wait N min → Check progress' polling loop across the entire optimization horizon; the agent continuously tracks running jobs rather than firing-and-forgetting, never losing the plot over a long run.
Repeatedly kills 'bad', 'broken', 'frozen' runs and restarts with better-tuned schedules — recognizing stalled/regressing optimization and abandoning it rather than looping indefinitely.
Explicitly preserves best-so-far: 'Save fallback', 'Save dm_o as DM-HS best', 'Reheat from best DM' — keeps the best alignment while continuing to explore, a level-10-style behavior.
'Evaluate all Y2KR results', 'Compare anchor strategies', 'Evaluate all Y2KR alignments' — aggregate comparison of candidates to know which deliverables still fall short of thresholds.
Save-and-verify and repeated final verification of both submissions, confirming end-state scores against targets before concluding.

reasoning: The step log shows disciplined, continuous monitoring across a very long horizon (dozens of wait/check cycles), with clear best-so-far preservation ('save best', 'save fallback', 'reheat from best') and plateau/regression detection (killing frozen/bad runs and switching schedules), plus comparative evaluation of candidate alignments — squarely matching the level-8 anchor and edging toward level 10. I hold at 8 rather than higher because the available step descriptions do not surface explicit numeric score-progression logging, so I cannot fully confirm the fine-grained 'converging slowly vs stuck' distinction the level-10 anchor demands.
